verdict.rationale: Insomnia's AI features documentation shows two built-in, task-specific AI capabilities: generating a mock server from a natural-language prompt, OpenAPI definition or URL (auto-scaffolding routes and responses), and suggesting commit messages. There is no evidence of a general-purpose assistant you can hand arbitrary tasks to, and the MCP client only connects to external servers rather than providing an in-app assistant. missing for 10: a general-purpose in-app AI assistant or agent for arbitrary tasks (e.g. building requests, writing tests or scripts, debugging responses), multi-step agentic task execution, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI features.
